sources.title: Intern-S2-Mobius: Foundation Model with Decoupled Knowledge and Reasoning
sources.snippet: Upon switching to the knowledge-reasoning-decoupled Mobius architecture, the model can attain superior compression rates, thereby enabling it to acquire sufficient knowledge with substantially less training data.

sources.snippet: Built upon Mobius-v0 architecture: 1) Our 7B model trained-from-scratch achieves similar downstream score as a 7B Transformer baseline with 62.6% of baseline's training data. 2) Our Intern-S2-Mobius, continually-pretrained from Qwen3.5-35B, achieves similar downstream score while delivering nearly 4x end-to-end inference speedup.
